strategies.name: Baseline Sequential All-Reduce Chain
strategies.desc: Direct implementation of 8 sequential all-reduce operations with interleaved local bidiagonal coupling/decoupling transformations. 8 all-reduce dispatches on full (world_size*1024) tensors. Represents the reference baseline with maximum communication volume but simplest structure.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter + All-Gather Decomposition
strategies.desc: Replace each all-reduce with reduce-scatter (producing S-sized local shard) followed by all-gather to reconstruct full vector. 16 collective dispatches (8 RS + 8 AG) but each RS operates on decreasing data and AG can overlap with local computation. Trades dispatch count for potentially better bandwidth utilization on large world sizes.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction (Intra+Inter Node)
strategies.desc: Exploit num_nodes topology by performing intra-node all-reduce (within each node's devices) then inter-node all-reduce, with bidiagonal transforms at appropriate levels. For 224 ranks this creates ~28 nodes of 8 devices each, reducing cross-node traffic. 16 dispatches (8 stages × 2 levels) but smaller inter-node payloads.

strategies.name: Pipelined Reduce-Scatter with Overlapped Transforms
strategies.desc: Segment the tensor into chunks and pipeline reduce-scatter operations across stages, applying bidiagonal coupling to already-reduced chunks while later chunks still communicate. Maintains 8 logical stages but increases dispatch count to ~8-16 while enabling computation-communication overlap. Trades latency for throughput via pipelining.

strategies.name: Fused Coupling with Neighbor Exchange
strategies.desc:
Since bidiagonal coupling only requires adjacent shards (r and r+1), use targeted send/recv or all-to-all to exchange boundary data instead of full all-reduce. Each rank computes its own shard's final result via 8 rounds of: local accumulation + boundary exchange + coupling update. 16-24 dispatches (smaller point-to-point ops) trading full replication for minimal data movement.
